Brain Age 2 - More Training in Minutes a.name: Brain Age 2: More Training in Minutes a Day!
Brain Age 2 - More Training in Minutes a.summary: Brain Age 2: More Training in Minutes a Day contains all-new activities to challenge a player's gray matter. The title is a series of trainings designed to give the brain a workout. The 17 new, engaging activities are all designed to help work the brain. Whether players are playing simple songs on a piano keyboard or monitoring the photo finish of a footrace, they'll love this new mental workout.

Build-A-Bear Workshop - Welcome to Hugsv.name: Build-a-Bear Workshop: Welcome to Hugsville
Build-A-Bear Workshop - Welcome to Hugsv.summary:
Welcome to Hugsville!

Welcome to Hugsville! Build-A-Bear Workshop mascots Bearemy and Pawlette Coufur guide you throughout this open-ended adventure. Explore the world, decorate your home, play games, or chat with friends!

Features:

• 13 playable furry friends to choose from and customize
• Go on quests, build and create, play local wireless mini-games with your furry friends, and more!
• 5 different "Fun Zones" featuring mini-games, including the Beach, Forest, Jungle, Desert and Icecap.
• Collect items to unlock new gameplay and rewards.

Club Penguin - Elite Penguin Force.summary: Club Penguin: Elite Penguin Force is a DS game based on Disney's popular online world Club Penguin

Mamegoma - Honobono Nikki.name: Mamegoma: Honobono Nikki
Mamegoma - Honobono Nikki.summary: Communicate with Mamegoma through words and touch! You become a foster parent for Mamegoma and raise it for one year by feeding it, cleaning it, and teaching it language. They will respond to calls and show you various expressions. 16 + 6 new types Mamegoma are included! You can take pictures in the game and exchange them with your friends!

Natalie Brooks - The Treasures of the Lo.name: Natalie Brooks: The Treasures of the Lost Kingdom
Natalie Brooks - The Treasures of the Lo.summary: Search for an ancient treasure map and discover the mystery of a terrible curse in Natalie Brooks - The Treasures of the Lost Kingdom. Search stunning scenes for hidden objects and find the ancient treasure map before it's too late. Featuring animated locations, challenging mini-games, and more, this original challenge is a stirring adventure. Join Natalie on her exciting search today!

Scribblenauts.name: Scribblenauts
Scribblenauts.summary:
What Will You Write?

Help Maxwell reach the Starlite by solving each challenge. Write any object you can think of and watch it come to life. Try another word and watch an entirely different solution unfold. With your stylus and imagination, the possibilities are endless!

Slide Adventure - Mag Kid.name: Slide Adventure: Magkid
Slide Adventure - Mag Kid.summary:
On a dark night, a lightning storm struck the house and brought to life all kinds of strange creatures. It also brought to life a fridge magnet called Mag Kid.

The game was mentioned in the Super Smash Bros. series as the officially romanized title of "Slide Adventure: MAGKID"
